meta.source: integrityinfrastructure.com snapshot (Divi 4.27.9) in the repo: inline CSS, logo PNG, service icons

color.note: Themes are the four site concepts. The brand primitives never change between them; semantic tokens (surface, text, accent-text, focus-ring...) carry each concept's look. Text on orange is always ink.

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: UI brand orange, taken from the live site CSS. Fills for primary buttons, CTA bands, key figures and active states. Text on it is always on-accent (ink, 6.06:1). White on it measures 2.96:1 and fails WCAG AA: the live site's white-on-orange CTA bands are retired, not copied.

tokens.name: logo-orange
tokens.usage: Orange inside the logo artwork (the legacy service icons use #f17b25). Asset-only: never a UI fill or text color. It differs from brand-orange; the master value needs client confirmation.

tokens.name: flame-yellow
tokens.usage: Inner flame of the logo. Work Light focus ring (12.8:1 on surface) and small highlights on dark grounds only. Never text or a fill on light grounds, where it falls under 1.5:1.

tokens.name: flame-cream
tokens.usage: Flame core inside the logo. Asset-only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Near-black from the live site CSS. Body text on every light surface, text on brand-orange, and the Work Light raised surface.

tokens.name: logo-ink
tokens.usage: Wordmark color inside the logo PNG. Asset-only; UI black is ink.

tokens.name: orange-100
tokens.usage: Tag and selected-row wash on light surfaces; ink text on it (15.5:1).

tokens.name: orange-200
tokens.usage: Hover wash for list rows on light surfaces; ink text on it.

tokens.name: orange-400
tokens.usage: Link hover on dark surfaces (9.2:1 on neutral-950).

tokens.name: orange-500
tokens.usage: Alias of brand-orange so the ramp reads in order.

tokens.name: orange-600
tokens.usage: Display figures 24px and larger on light surfaces (3.6:1 on neutral-50). Never body text.

tokens.name: orange-700
tokens.usage: Orange text on light surfaces: 5.71:1 on neutral-0, 5.28:1 on neutral-50, 4.96:1 on neutral-100, 4.57:1 on neutral-150.

tokens.name: orange-800
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for orange text on light surfaces (6.1:1 on neutral-100).

tokens.name: neutral-0
tokens.usage: Raised surface in As-Built and Crew: cards, forms, spec plates. Near-white; never pure #fff.

tokens.name: neutral-25
tokens.usage: Crew page background.

tokens.name: neutral-50
tokens.usage: As-Built page background; body text in Work Light (17.4:1 on neutral-950).

tokens.name: neutral-100
tokens.usage: Sunken bands on the light concepts (FAQ, footer strip, alternating sections).

tokens.name: neutral-150
tokens.usage: Hover fill for quiet buttons and rows on the light concepts.

tokens.name: neutral-200
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines on light surfaces. Not for control borders (use neutral-500).

tokens.name: neutral-300
tokens.usage: Muted text over photography, always on scrim (6.1:1 over an 82% scrim on a white sky).

tokens.name: neutral-400
tokens.usage: Muted text on Work Light surfaces (7.1:1 on neutral-950, 6.7:1 on neutral-900).

tokens.name: neutral-500
tokens.usage: Form control borders in every concept: 3.2:1 or better on every surface they sit on, hover fills included.

tokens.name: neutral-600
tokens.usage: Muted text on light surfaces (5.7:1 on neutral-50, 5.4:1 on neutral-100).

tokens.name: neutral-700
tokens.usage: Strong rules on Work Light surfaces.

tokens.name: neutral-800
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines on Work Light surfaces.

tokens.name: neutral-850
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows and quiet buttons in Work Light.

tokens.name: neutral-900
tokens.usage: Alias of ink; the Work Light raised surface (the live site's section color).

tokens.name: neutral-950
tokens.usage: Work Light page background.

tokens.name: neutral-1000
tokens.usage: Work Light sunken bands and footer. Lit Fiber page surface.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Work Light neutral-950; As-Built neutral-50; Crew neutral-25; Lit Fiber neutral-1000, the deepest black, so glass panels and the orange light read.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, forms, spec plates, the header once scrolled. Carries text, text-muted and accent-text. Lit Fiber: the opaque equivalent of its glass panels (6% white over the surface), used for contrast checks.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Alternating bands (FAQ, footer strip). Carries text, text-muted and accent-text (4.96:1 minimum). Lit Fiber lifts instead of sinking (neutral-950): its surface is already the darkest step.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for quiet buttons, menu rows and job rows.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Rare inverted blocks such as tooltips; pages never flip to it section by section. Text on it is text-inverse.

tokens.name: surface-accent
tokens.usage: Orange color field: Crew values band, CTA bands. Text on it is on-accent; focus rings on it use focus-ring-on-accent.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (15:1 or better in every theme).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (5.3:1 minimum).

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: text-on-photo
tokens.usage: Headlines and body over photography, always on scrim (10.3:1 even over a white sky).

tokens.name: text-on-photo-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text over photography, always on scrim (6.1:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, active nav marker, key figures on dark. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill; ink text on it holds 7.2:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent, accent-hover and surface-accent (6.06:1). Never white.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Orange text and links on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken: 6.0:1 or better in Work Light, 4.96:1 or better on the light concepts.

tokens.name: accent-text-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state for accent-text links.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card outlines. Never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Rules that organize data: As-Built spec plates, table heads, the footer top rule.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, checkboxes and quiet buttons: 3.2:1 or better on every surface in every theme.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring 3px outside the control, 12:1 or better on every surface it lands on.

tokens.name: focus-ring-on-accent
tokens.usage: Focus ring for controls sitting on an orange field (6.06:1 on brand-orange).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, invalid field borders and the error-summary rule: 7.3:1 on neutral-900 in Work Light, 5.6:1 or better on the light surfaces. Always paired with an icon and the word Error.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Form success and confirmations: 9.0:1 in Work Light, 5.3:1 or better on light surfaces. Blue, so it never relies on red versus green. Always paired with an icon.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Photo overlay behind text: the text side of every hero gradient and caption plate.

tokens.name: scrim-soft
tokens.usage: Photo toning where no text sits on the image.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Desktop sizes; pages scale them fluidly (see README). Concepts change weight, case and tracking, never the family.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero headline only; two lines at most.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Inner page headers and the Work Light services index.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Sub-sections, service names on the Services page.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Small titles: FAQ questions, job titles, form sections.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Ensure your network operates at peak performance with our expert fiber splicing services.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs under a hero or section title; 20 words or fewer in a hero.

styles.name: body-md
styles.sample: We handle both single-mode and multi-mode fibers, ensuring accurate splicing that minimizes signal loss.
styles.usage: Default body copy; keep lines under 70 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: 13565 SW Tualatin Sherwood Road, Suite 800, Sherwood, OR 97140
styles.usage: Footer, captions, helper text under fields.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Uppercase meta labels: tags, the one eyebrow a page may carry per three sections.

styles.name: figure-lg
styles.usage: Key figures and the phone number in CTA bands; set with tabular figures.

groups.name: Wide accent
groups.note: Michroma is already on the live site (the SERVICES heading). As-Built only.

styles.name: wide-label
styles.usage: As-Built spec-plate labels and figure captions; uppercase, never body text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; label-to-field gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related lines: title and meta in a job row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; padding inside tags and small panels.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; gap in card grids.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between a section title and its content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablet; As-Built section rhythm.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop (Work Light).

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop (Crew and Lit Fiber, the most open concepts).

radius.note: Each concept locks one corner system: Work Light is all-sharp, As-Built is 2px everywhere, Crew is 16px cards and media with pill buttons and tags and 8px fields, Lit Fiber is 32px glass shells with 24px cores, pill actions and 16px fields.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Work Light: every surface, control and image.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: As-Built: every surface, control and image.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Crew form fields.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Crew cards and media.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Crew buttons and tags.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Lit Fiber inner cores and media: the panel radius minus the 8px shell inset, so curves stay concentric.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Lit Fiber outer shells: cards, plates, the CTA band and the veil menu.

shadow.note: Work Light and As-Built separate surfaces with borders, not shadows. Crew uses one soft, ink-tinted shadow. Lit Fiber uses a deep, diffuse shadow plus a 1px inner highlight, the glass panel's top edge.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and media on the page. Lit Fiber adds the inner highlight of its glass panels here.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: The mobile nav drawer and the sticky header once scrolled.

layout.note: Container and header sizes shared by every concept.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Widest content column.

tokens.name: container-text
tokens.usage: Long-form text column, about 68 characters of body-md.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Page gutter at 1024px and up.

tokens.name: gutter-mobile
tokens.usage: Page gutter under 768px.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Desktop header height.

tokens.name: header-height-mobile
tokens.usage: Header height under 1024px.

breakpoint.note: Min-width breakpoints; mirror them in Oxygen's breakpoint settings.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones: two-up tags, inline form rows.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablet: multi-column sections begin.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Desktop nav replaces the drawer.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Full container width.

zIndex.note: The only layers the site uses.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky site header.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Mobile nav drawer and its backdrop.

tokens.name: z-skip
tokens.usage: Skip link when focused.
